To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of an exact model matching controller with simultaneous disturbance rejection is given; (ii) the analytical expression of the exact model matching controller is derived, and the controller is realizable.

the EMMDR problem for neutral multi-delay systems is solvable if and only if the desired model is left-invertible and that a general expression of the realizable controller matrices solving the EMMDR is derived.

we have developed necessary and sufficient conditions, and an analytical expression, of the controller matrices for exact model matching and disturbance attenuation for a class of general linear time delay neutral systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the problem of exact model following with disturbance rejection for linear time delay systems with multiple delays and disturbances, via proportional measurement output feedback, and the following results are achieved.

the problem of exact model-matching with simultaneous disturbance-rejection for general linear neutral multi-delay systems with measurable disturbances and outputs, via proportional realisable controller.
the problem of exact model-matching for linear systems with multiple time delays, via measurement output feedback, and the problem of disturbance rejection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in general, the problem of EMMDR has been resolved for general neutral multi delay systems, via proportional measurement output feedback, with a realizable solution.
the results obtained in this thesis have been successfully applied to the design and implementation of an engine controller.

the problem of exact model-matching with simultaneous disturbance rejection for general neutral multi- delay systems is solvable via measurement output feedback, provided the desired model is left-invertible, and the analytical expression of the realizable solution is given by (3.2.3).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, for a general neutral multi-delay system with measurable disturbance and measurement outputs, the necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of a solution for the EMMDR problem is that its transfer function has a right coprime factorization, where the right coprime factors are left-invertible and the left coprime factors have no zeros in the open right-half plane.
, the problem of EMMDR for general linear multi-delay systems is solvable if the desired model has a left-inverse.

, for a class of linear neutral multi-delay systems with left invertible desired model, the problem of EMMDR via measurement output feedback has a realizable solution if and only if the desired model can be exactly matched with zero disturbance by the system itself.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed controller design approach can be successfully applied to real world systems, and it is a promising approach for the design of controllers with good performance.
, for a large class of neutral multi-delay systems with left invertible desired models, the EMMDR problem has a solution and this solution can be obtained by solving a set of linear equations.
the proposed method can be applied to control IC engine, and that it has a good potential in controlling the IC engine in real time.
